estilo: Hand-painted fantasy RPG world map region seen from a high bird's-eye angle, wide panoramic landscape, rich painterly detail, Octopath Traveler and Final Fantasy concept art style, soft atmospheric lighting, open ground in the middle for map markers.
negativo: text, letters, labels, watermark, signature, frame, border, compass, people, characters, UI, grid

trabajos.map_ceniza: The Ashen Forest: a burned dark forest of charred black trees and grey ash ground, glowing orange embers and small lava cracks, drifting smoke, a few surviving red autumn trees, a winding dirt trail from left to right, warm ember glow.
trabajos.map_pantano: The Shadow Swamp: murky green bog with twisted mangrove trees draped in moss, glowing green pools and giant mushrooms, wooden boardwalks winding left to right, low eerie fog, fireflies.
trabajos.map_glaciar: The Runic Glacier: snowy frozen mountains and blue glacier ice fields, frozen pine trees, ancient glowing blue rune stones in the snow, an icy trail winding left to right, cold clear light, snowfall.
trabajos.map_desierto: The Amber Desert: golden sand dunes and sandstone mesas, ancient half-buried ruins and pillars, glowing amber crystals, a caravan trail winding left to right, hot sunset light.
trabajos.map_abismo: The Volcanic Abyss: black obsidian rock wasteland with rivers of glowing lava, floating purple void crystals and dark rifts in the ground, a basalt path winding left to right, purple and red ominous glow.
trabajos.title_bg: Epic key art panorama: a cozy medieval fantasy village at dusk with timber houses and warm lanterns in the foreground, a giant glowing blue runic portal in the village square, and in the sky above a huge jagged magical rift tearing the clouds open with violet light, distant mountains, cinematic, no characters.
